lastCompletedStory.title: Registrar tokens-por-ciclo no event log no cycle-close

nextStoryContext: US-001 ships recordCycleTokens() in src/commands/journal.ts and CycleTokensEventDetail + cycle-tokens WorkerEventKind in src/supervisor/events.ts. The function is fully injectable (readOrchTranscript, readEventLog, logEvent). The per-cycle slice logic is: sum worker 'tokens' events after the last 'cycle-tokens' event in the event log. Production callers (e.g. cycle-close in the orchestrator) should import recordCycleTokens from src/commands/journal.ts and pass cwd + claudeDir. No wiring in loop.ts or sidecar yet (CAM-136 / future story).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story touches only internal modules (journal.ts, events.ts, transcript/usage.ts). No external library.
